steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Hit me.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Strength from the ground, fist and feet communicating. Always be aware of what's under your step! Stand up!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Do not chase the hands, do not clash with the body. See my movements clearly, be aware of your own self! Stand up!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yes, Dad!

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: When we train in kung fu, you call me Shih-fu!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Strength through six harmonies, force within one ts'un! Is this how little power your fists hold?!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (Panting) Yes...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Dad? Where are you going?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: To find something. Something that can make me stronger.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Can you take me with you? Don't leave me all alone...

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I won't stop to wait for you. If you want to stand by my side, then catch me, by your own efforts.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Dad—

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It just doesn't make sense!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Hei-yo, it's been madness these days. Not one day of calm.

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: What? What doesn't click about what I just said, Miss Heroine?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'm being framed, head to tail! What proof do you have it was me who injured your schoolbrother?

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: This recording's the proof. If you have any doubts, we could report it to the authorities. Let them decide if this is 'harm with intent,' right?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: This recording's clearly out of context. I wasn't even using any strength there. How could that possibly hurt him?

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Those are some big words! If it took no strength to get our second-in-line so hurt, he'd be dead if you put any effort into it, wouldn't he?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: A coin for a coin, a life for a life. When you hurt someone... you'd better cough up their hospital fees. Here's the bill for your perusal.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: This much?!

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Our schoolbrother kickboxes to feed himself. If he can't fight anymore, that's every meal for the rest of his life gone with it. Of course he needs careful treatment.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I—I don't have this much.

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Of course. You're so young; it's understandable you have no savings. We're not out just to trouble you here. But we have a way.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: What way?

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: You take on this written challenge. Our first-in-line invites you to a kung fu competition three days from now, for our school to uphold its name.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I go for another round so you can stick another battery charge on me?

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Don't be so sure of yourself. You only beat our second after he held back out of kindness, and our first's skill is in a league beyond his. Victory is up in the air.

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Only, our second's still lying in hospital, so winning this will be... well, you think about it, Miss Heroine.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I understand. You want me to lose on purpose, or else you'll keep hanging this 'harm with intent' thing over me.

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Hey, hey, let's be clear, those were your words just now, not mine.

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Made your choice? It's the bill or the challenge. One or the other, you know?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Fine... I accept the challenge.

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Then go ahead and sign it with your mark. At noon, three days from now, the Plated Fists will arrange a feast at the Jianlan Tavern in the mountains. We insist you grace us, when the time comes.

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Also, we'll be holding onto this recording for now. If you skip Shangshu all by yourself, don't blame us when—

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Say no more. Three days from now? I'll be there.

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Hahaha. You're a forthright one, Miss Heroine. Until then.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You crooked punk—
Hours earlier...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Shoot... I was only a few days behind, and Uncle Lee's already out of Shangshu. Uncle Liang chose this exact time to transfer, too. Now can I talk to...?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Um, what's that up ahead?

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: This is the grand ten-year anniversary of our Plated Fist opening a training hall in Shangshu, and we'll be performing on this stage.

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: Thanks to our fellow townspeople and our martial allies, everyone who signs up for a course today gets 30% off!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Is kung fu really this thick in the air in Shangshu? I might just get leads on my dad, if I ask around here.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: This guy in front's got a sturdy figure, and he seems pretty skilled. Let's see what kind of show he puts on.

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: Brothers and sisters, let us display the Eighty One Techniques of the Plated Fist, and give the audience a taste of our kung fu!

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: These techniques have been a closely-guarded secret, but today is the day we make an exception! We'll open your eyes!

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioners
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hm... a lot of the apprentices in the back move slightly stiffly. They're lacking both coordination and force. Probably still haven't been training for long. Commendable vigor, though.

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: The Techniques of the Plated Fist are time-honored and deep-rooted. If you train hard, you'll be guaranteed to improve your health and live longer.

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: I'll show you all the results of extended, intense training in our secret techniques! Brother, bring it out!

steps.name: Staged(?) Female Passerby
steps.text: S-Such thick marble, and three blocks at once! Is he going to split them all in one chop?

steps.name: Staged(?) Male Passerby
steps.text: There's no way! No human could ever pull off something like this!

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: Everyone, watch carefully—hyah!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Kung fu isn't about simple, brute force. Isn't drawing all this attention a little overboard...?

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: Hahaha, that was nothing. Train our techniques to the highest level, and you won't need punches or kicks—you can hurt people with your mind alone!

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: Observe. With just one chop of the air, I can blast someone over ten meters away!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Brother! I'll face you!

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: Good on you! This is a heavy one, so be careful! Hyah—

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: This is all so fake!

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: Miss, we haven't met, have we? What are you smearing our kung fu for?!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Smearing? It's incredible you act so righteous while you trick people with this cheap act.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: 'Hitting people with the air?' What are you teaching, martial arts or Originium Arts?

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: Hahahaha... Miss, you've seen nothing. I'm not arguing with you.

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: You have to understand, once a man develops his physical potential to the very limit, kickboxing is mightier than Originium Arts could ever be.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Really? As luck has it, I've been training for a couple years too. I'd like to ask, seeing as you're my senior—what power does your fist at 'the very limits' have there?

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: She's coming at you! Quick, get down!

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: What kind of house or school are you from? Are you really going to fight me in front of a crowd?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'm from no house or school. If your conscience is clear, why should you care how many people are watching?

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: Fine, then each of us makes three moves and no more, the kung fu way. You can go first, since you're a girl.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Are you sure you want me to go first?

steps.name: Second Apprentice
steps.text: What, are you scared?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (This guy probably never practiced any real kung fu. Take a little care. Let's not hurt him.)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (Just make him fall on his face. All he needs is a little humble pie.)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Alright, haiyah!

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Brother! Brother!

steps.name: Female Passerby
steps.text: Eek! He's not getting up, he's not moving! Is he foaming at the mouth?

steps.name: Male Passerby
steps.text: Run! That might've been a murder!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: W-What? I didn't put any force into that!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I didn't find out anything about Uncle Lee or my dad, and I got sucked into this mess to boot. If Aak finds out, he'll die laughing.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I can't let that bunch of kung fu cheats carry on their evildoing, but if they went to the authorities...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: How do I handle this?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Who's there? Come out!
Relax, Miss Heroine!
There's Plated Fist people in the shadows all around here. I have to be careful not to catch their attention.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Who are you, and what do you want with me?
I'm a student of the Traceless Fist. Don't worry, Miss Heroine, I've nothing to do with the Plated at all.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Who knew Shangshu had so many schools of kung fu?

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: There's close to fifty in all, big and small. The Plated you offended yesterday number as one of the largest. You don't know just how big of a headache you've made for yourself, I worry.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: They extorted me for about two years' worth of my wages. I couldn't be clearer.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: This isn't a simple matter of money. When you crashed their stage yesterday in front of everyone, you may as well have smashed up their sign, and that's the biggest taboo in the kung fu world.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: They're going to regain face in the coming challenge, no holds barred. No matter how supreme your kung fu, I fear alone, you'll be...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Let me ask this. You're a martial artist too. You'd sit back and watch them so blatantly swindle people?

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: You may not know this, but we've always had a rule: We of the martial ways don't spoil our fellows' livelihoods.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: If sides are displayed winning or losing in a public setting, then it's common for the loser to offer a 'reconciliation gift,' and then arrange for a feast.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: The two sides each send a representative, the two publicly discuss how no one style is inferior to another, and they go back to minding their own business.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: If someone violates this rule, then all the schools target them, ensuring it's hard for them to find their footing in Shangshu.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I mean, I'm against going around challenging schools too, but doesn't this stink of a sham?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: And on top of that, you make it sound like you're all cozy with each other. Are you saying you do things pretty much the way the Plated do too?

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: We just exaggerate a little to advertise—let's put that aside for now. The main thing I'm here for is to make you a deal. An excellent one.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: You declare to everyone that you're a follower of our Traceless Fist, and then our school sends someone to make peace with the Plated. That way, all your troubles are gone.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You called this a 'deal.' I assume I have to do something?

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Of course. There's always a give-and-take in the kung fu world. All we hope for, after things settle down, is that you come to our hall and be a nominal instructor for a month.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: A nominal instructor?

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Haha, we won't make you teach us your secret techniques, of course. We just want you to stay with us. You can act as living publicity for our school.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: We won't make you stay for free, either. We'll pay you a month's wages, and split the Plated Fists' reconciliation gift 20/80! How do those terms s—

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Are you done?

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: You've made up your mind?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'll kindly refuse.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Er... If you feel it's an unfair price, we can still discuss—

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Listen. I may not be totally in the loop about this kung fu 'business,' and I'm probably not qualified to wax on about the rules and customs and so on?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: But to my eyes, this fraud has no fundamental respect for the martial arts at all. I would never accept it.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Miss Heroine, you seem to be mistaken...

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: The age of true kung fu is long gone... We're all just putting on a show to make a living. That's not some terrible crime.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: All we ever need is to save a little face. Why take this so seriously?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Maybe you're right. Maybe I shouldn't judge the lives of others so lightly.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: We're just of different mind and different ways. Thank you for your 'kindness,' and goodbye.

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Come on... You're so young, girl. Why are you clinging to something so old-fashioned?

steps.name: Traceless Fist Practitioner
steps.text: What era do you think this is? All the real warriors have been beaten to death by now...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Dad, is your kung fu so strong that nobody could beat you?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: What a joke.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: How vast do you think the land is? Just because I pass through a few cities with no opponent, I can pretend I'm number one?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: But you've trained so hard, and you look for opponents everywhere. So why?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Training is training. Why all the 'why?'

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: All I'm doing is seeking the masters, finding the peaks. Only by witnessing the heights of the sky and the breadths of the land can I know where I stand, can I go further!

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: To reach the 'peak of perfection' of the martial way, that is my life's wish!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Dad, just what is it you're searching for, even now...?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: There's a rough face you're pulling, guest. Not used to Shangshu spice?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: No, not that. The food's great, it's just my own worries.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Peheh, I happened to overhear. Those people made a fine racket in the inn yesterday, and I heard talk of you getting caught up in it.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I must've made a mockery of myself—no, I'm the one who got you caught up in this.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: No harm done. What are you planning to do now, though, Miss?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I know what. I've already agreed to the challenge, so I have to show up. And I'm going to have a fair and square martial competition with them, no tricks or schemes.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It's something all martial artists understand. 'Seek to go forth, think not to halt.' I made this mess myself, so no matter what happens, it's my responsibility to bear it.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Fine words. Your righteousness is commendable, young lady, but I think you should know what it means to take it all on yourself.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: The first apprentice, in your upcoming match, is probably just as much a martial nobody. But if they're scrambling to control the damage, whipping out every dirty trick in the book, do you think you'll cope with the onslaught?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'll do all I can.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: And further, if you win, and they kick off and call you the wrongdoer instead, then I'm sorry, but even if their sort can't lay hands on you, it'd never be worth it to get tangled in a lawsuit.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Besides, ultimately, you can't stomach the way they connive together, pulling their dirty tricks. Even if you teach the Plated Fists a lesson, what use will that be in the kung fu circle of Shangshu?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You have a point, sir...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I don't like to lecture on my seniority. But I hope you give some weight to what I've told you, young lady.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'm not interested in meaningless scuffles, and at the same time I don't want those people getting what they wish for. But no matter what, I can't see a way I can pull off both.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: There's always some way. You just have to think a little outside the box to find it.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Outside the box, you say...?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The way the world works, it's like a net. Sometimes it's protective, and sometimes it ties you up like a finfish—and it's not something you can use your fists to shake off.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: In this net, the way you act and carry yourself gets bound up, and there's rules to play by. Know what it wants, and you'll know what it fears.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Just rambling, rambling. You don't need to understand what it means just yet, hahaha...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Know what it means, know what it fears...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: They won't let me go without a match, and it's just to win back their reputation.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: If they love face so much, I could just give them some.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It looks like you have a plan, young lady?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Thank you for your advice, sir. I think I've got a solution!

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: What's happening? Who invited so many other halls here?

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: We don't know! We heard your warning, we kept away from all the other schools!

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: Even the 'Yin-Yang,' 'Seven Shocks' and 'White Feather' houses are here. You think they just came on their own?

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Please, brother! I genuinely have no idea what happened!

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: I'll get you all for this later! Is the one who beat up our second here yet?

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: She is! She's over there!

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: What's with that flag she's holding?
With all eyes on her, Waai Fu ascends the arena, and stands a flagpole easily a zhang high in the center. The banner flutters, on one side written '#1 in Shangshu,' an awe-inspiring scene.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (Innkeeper Zheng really did invite all these people.)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (I've never spoken in front of this many before. I'm kind of nervous...)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (Huff—)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Ahem—Thank you, martial minds, for accepting the invitation to this meeting.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I am Waai Fu, taught in the ways of the Hong Mei Wing Chun. I had the privilege to meet the followers of the Plated Fist some days ago. It was perhaps even... instant chemistry.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: My seniors are determined to exhibit their house's prowess, and invite me upon this stage with them, so we can compete for number one in Shangshu kung fu.

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: What?! You l—

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It was the Plated who arranged for this feast. Isn't that true?

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: Zheng Q—Innkeeper Zheng, what are you doing here?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It's the most interesting thing to happen to our kung fu in a while. Let a rickety man join in the fun.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: No need to greet me, you sit for now.

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: Very well...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Though I can only speak for so little, I want to do my own part to revitalize the kung fu scene here, so I've taken it upon myself to establish this challenge.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Whoever bests me gets this '#1 in Shangshu' flag. The last one standing on this stage takes it to hang it in their own hall.

steps.name: Seven Shocks Fist House
steps.text: Good nephew, I hear your house's master has been traveling far as of recent. You truly show determination for your school in arranging this battle as its first disciple.

steps.name: White Feather Fist House
steps.text: It seems the Plated Fist's undertakings are so grand, Shangshu alone couldn't hold them anymore.

steps.name: Yin-Yang Fist House
steps.text: Go on, then. Take up that flag and give us old fogeys a good slap and a what-for, hm?

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: Honored Shih-fus, this is all wrong, it's a misunderstanding...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I thought it would be a shame to take up your invitation to the Plated Fist's banquet but have no one to fight, so... what say you about this contest, schoolbrother?

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: You must be joking, Miss... I've only invited everyone here for some tea and a meal. What's this talk of competition?

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: If you would just quickly put this banner away...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Er, could it be I misunderstood your intent, brother?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Alright. If that's what you say, then that's what I'll heed. This contest today is thus canceled.
Waai Fu makes a quick sideways chop, and the solid wood flagpole, thick as a wide bowl, topples in answer. The '#1 in Shangshu' banner lands neatly in her hands.

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Wow, look at how thick that pole was, and the cut even looks genuine!

steps.name: Plated Fist Practitioner
steps.text: Brother, I want to learn that! When will Shih-fu teach us that?

steps.name: First Apprentice
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: If there's nothing else today, I'll be taking my leave for now, so as not to spoil your teatime mood.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'll keep this flag in my care for now. If anyone still wants this '#1 in Shangshu' title, you can challenge me at any time. I'll gladly offer up this flag to you, if you beat me.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: May fate bid us to meet again, martial minds.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Thank you, sir. Without your help, that could've been a much stickier situation.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: No thanks necessary. You came up with the plan yourself, really. I just sent a few letters, nothing worth mentioning.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You have more than diligent training. There's a fine, clever mind in there too. Very rare.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: *Sigh*... You know, my own little girl's around your age, and she has kung fu to speak of at that. If she were half as prudent as you, I wouldn't be getting so many white hairs.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I really am flattered, sir.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Is something still troubling you, even after getting free of that mess?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I've learned martial arts from my father ever since I was young. The one thing he said to me most was 'Martial arts have yin and yang, humans have straight and crooked.' With improper intent, you'll never master your kung fu.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I always thought every fighter would be like my father, set on martial progress and nothing else. Now I've seen the way the martial world's become, and I feel like it's just not right.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: The martial world is wherever the martial artists are. There's people devoted to the way, like your father, and of course there's people just in it for a living. But in the end, the 'martial world' is still bound to fade away.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: The schools you see now were different decades ago. But the longer the days of peace, the less traveling the country calls for kung fu in your pocket. The training gets less diligent in turn.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: They say 'martial arts to halt a war.' When the people no longer need martial arts, that's the day we'll truly be at peace.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Sir, about that. I have a small objection.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Oh? Go ahead, young lady.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: The halls all think times are peaceful enough not to need any kung fu, and my father's been searching for an opponent all his life... I've been thinking over it these past few days, and I feel—the martial arts don't need anything external to show their worth.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Martial arts are like a mirror, they reflect your own will, your own state of mind. Practicing them is recognizing yourself. It's that one, 'with no purpose and no self, there is no boundary and no end'.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: That's what I believe for sure. Or maybe that's just... the arrogance of the young.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Hahahahaha, well said! I was thinking all these schools in Shangshu would end up vanishing in a few years, if they were left alone.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: But what I've seen these past few days really changed my mind. At least in this moment, every day the martial world still exists is a day it should live loud and strong.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: If there's no one in the 'business' who'll rectify the mood, I won't mind wading in myself.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Really?! Sir, I would absolutely be willing to help you, if that's what you think!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Haha, your feelings are loud and clear, young lady. But it's a long, long way to build, and you've got more pressing things to do right now, don't you?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Huh? How do you know—

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: A man by the name of Lee left a letter here a few days ago. He said a girl called Waai would come to Shangshu looking for him, and to hand it to her.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I worried it'd buck your mood back then, so I didn't bring it up. Now's the time to give it to you.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: A letter from Uncle Lee?!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: To my fine niece Waai Fu, I hope this letter finds you well. I've gotten ahold of some news about your father, and I'm right on my way back to... Lungmen?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: So I made this whole trip for nothing?!
